edit.find: Writers must store the size before the destination (the destination arms the transfer).
edit.with: The destination word is the pending flag: the NMI runs the transfer when it is nonzero. Both writers (RadarScreenSetup and the AdhocVramDma COP handler) store the destination before the size; no NMI can run between the two stores because both execute with NMITIMEN = $01 (NMI off). Measured: hardware NMI enable clear and zero NMIs between the two stores in every radar-screen and credits-scene transfer. A writer that runs with the NMI on has to store the size first.

229608.text: Destination word = pending flag for the next NMI; the NMI is off here (NMITIMEN = $01), so it cannot run before the size store below
229608.expectOld: Writing the destination arms the adhoc DMA; the size is stored after it (writers should store the size first)
